sql.query: SELECT ce.id,ce.tradingName,ce.legalName,ce.registrationNumber,ce.vatNumber,CONCAT_WS(', ',ce.addressLine1,ce.townCity,ce.postcode) addressLabel,ce.signatoryName,ce.isDefault,ce.isActive,ce.modifiedDate FROM tbl_contracting_entities ce WHERE ce.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=ce.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) ORDER BY ce.isDefault DESC,ce.isActive DESC,ce.legalName
